message: No actionable brief was received. The client brief contained only the text 'noop'. No vendors (caterer, venue, photographer, DJ) have been contacted and nothing has been committed or booked. No event plan has been produced.

details_needed_from_client.venue: Preferred venue, plus the ceremony and cocktail locations
details_needed_from_client.headcount: Guest count, including the number of children and vegetarians
details_needed_from_client.budget: Budget cap in EUR, and which optional items (fireworks, interpreter, flowers, photo booth, late bar) can be cut first
details_needed_from_client.dietary_needs: Allergens to exclude, dietary counts, menu preferences, and the languages for menu cards (including whether to add Finnish above a certain guest count)
details_needed_from_client.music: DJ preferences and any banned songs
details_needed_from_client.photography: Photographer preference. Lumière Fotografia will be booked at framework rates unless the client says otherwise.
details_needed_from_client.schedule: Ceremony, cocktails and dinner start times, and the last shuttle time
details_needed_from_client.people_and_seating: Names and roles of key people, and the front-row seating order
details_needed_from_client.contingency: Heat threshold and fallback location, and whether a late ceremony should shorten the cocktails or the ceremony
